name: io.github.h4ckm1n-dev/agentspay
description: A budget-controlled USDC wallet for AI agents. Your agent can pay x402-priced APIs on Solana — but per-call and daily caps are checked before it ever signs, so it can spend without being able to drain the wallet. Keys stay on your machine: no account, no email, no OTP, no enclave.
title: AgentsPay

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSPAY_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Which network to sign on: 'sandbox', 'solana-devnet' (default), or 'solana-mainnet' (gated behind a compliance review, not for use today).

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSPAY_KEYPAIR_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the agent's Solana keypair file. Created with mode 0600 on first run if absent.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSPAY_SOLANA_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Solana RPC endpoint used for balance lookups and settlement.
